title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. pi = pi_{0,3} is the fundamental group of U_{0,3} = P^1 - {0,1,infinity}. It is free on loops l_0, l_1, l_infinity with l_0 l_1 l_infinity = 1. Gamma_{0,3} (written with the same script letter as S_{0,3} on the previous page) is the extended Teichmueller group Aut_loc(pi_{0,3}): automorphisms preserving the inertia classes up to conjugacy, including the anti-holomorphic ones. Its quotient by Inn(pi) = pi is T_{0,3}, of order 12. T_{0,3} is S_3 x Z/2, where S_3 permutes 0, 1, infinity and Z/2 is generated by complex conjugation tau. Gamma^+ is the index-2 holomorphic part.

Equation (22). This is mislabelled (21) in the transcription. Using rho sigma_i rho^{-1} = sigma_{i+1} and (18), Grothendieck sets eps_0 = sigma_infinity rho = rho sigma_1, and similarly eps_1, eps_infinity. He states eps_i^2 = l_i.
- Check: (sigma_infinity rho)^2 = sigma_infinity (rho sigma_infinity rho^{-1}) rho^2 = sigma_infinity sigma_0 rho^{-1}.
- With (18) read as sigma_infinity sigma_0 = rho l_infinity = l_0 rho, this equals l_0.
- In S_3, sigma_infinity rho fixes 0, so eps_0 lies over the transposition sigma_0-dot.
- Thus eps_i is a non-torsion lift of the transposition fixing i: the half-twist exchanging the other two punctures. Its square is the full twist, which is the point-push l_i.
- Grothendieck claims eps_i is characterised among lifts by eps_i^2 = l_i.

Torsion inventory of T_{0,3}.
- 7 involutions: sigma_0, sigma_1, sigma_infinity, tau, tau'_0, tau'_1, tau'_infinity.
- 2 elements of order 3: rho, rho^{-1}.
- 2 elements of order 6: rho tau, rho^{-1} tau.
- All except the two of order 6 have been lifted to torsion elements of Gamma_{0,3}.
- The order-6 elements cannot be lifted (margin): their fixed-point sets are empty. Indeed (rho tau)^2 = rho^{-1} fixes only -j and -j-bar; (rho tau)^3 = tau fixes only the real line; the intersection is empty.

General principle invoked. Lifts of a finite-order outer element to torsion elements, up to pi-conjugation, correspond to connected components of its fixed-point set on U_{0,3}. Equivalently, they correspond to pi-orbits of fixed components on the universal cover. The cases:
- sigma_0 (z -> z/(z-1)): one fixed point, 2. Similarly sigma_1 fixes 1/2 and sigma_infinity fixes -1.
- tau'_i: each fixes a connected arc, e.g. the unit circle minus 1. So there is one class each.
- tau: fixes the real locus minus 3 points, which has 3 components. These give the 3 classes tau_0, tau_1, tau_infinity.
- rho: fixes the 2 points -j and -j-bar. He chooses the lift at -j. The other classes are obtained by conjugating by tau_i, as done on the next page (rho_i = tau_i rho tau_i^{-1}).

Purpose. This is explicit bookkeeping of the generators and relations of the 'tour de Teichmueller' at level (0,3). It serves the 'equation des lacets' and the action of Gal(Q-bar/Q) / GT on the tower. The torsion lifts and their conjugacy classes encode the 2- and 3-relations at the orbifold points of M_{0,4}.
errors: The equation is numbered (22), not (21): the previous page already has (21) and the next page continues with (23).

Formula (22) is consistent only if relation (18) on the previous page reads sigma_infinity sigma_0 = rho l_infinity = l_0 rho, not l_0 rho^{-1}. The previous-page transcription is wrong there, or Grothendieck slipped; the cyclic pattern and rho l_0 rho^{-1} = l_1 force l_0 rho.

In the parenthesis '(on a choisi sigma_0, sigma_1, sigma_infinity, tau_0, tau_1, tau_infinity...)' the elements meant for the one-class cases are the tau'_i; the tau_i are the three lifts of tau. This is a minor slip, either in the notes or in the transcription.
The uniqueness claim 'eps_i characterised by eps_i^2 = l_i' is asserted without proof. It is plausible (a free-group centraliser argument) but not checked on the page.
Fixed-point components should be taken in U_{0,3}, or as pi-orbits in its universal cover; the page's 'U = U_{0,3}^~' is ambiguous. The next page uses U_{0,3}.

ideas.what: Half-twist lifts eps_i = sigma_{i+2} rho = rho sigma_{i+1}, with eps_i^2 = l_i (square root of the point-push loop)
ideas.modern_name: Half-twist / braid generator in the mapping class group of the 4-punctured sphere, whose square is the Dehn twist equal to the point-push
ideas.where_published: Possibly implicit in La Longue Marche à travers la théorie de Galois (1981)

ideas.what: Torsion inventory of T_{0,3} = S_3 x Z/2: 7 involutions, 2 elements of order 3, 2 of order 6; the order-6 ones do not lift to torsion because their fixed-point set is empty
ideas.modern_name: Finite-order elements of extended mapping class groups and Nielsen realisation

ideas.what: Torsion lifts mod pi-conjugation correspond to connected components of the fixed-point set; the three lifts of complex conjugation correspond to the three real intervals of P^1 - {0,1,infinity}
ideas.modern_name: Topological / real section correspondence (real section conjecture, components of real points vs conjugacy classes of sections over Gal(C/R))
ideas.usually_credited_to: Real case: Cox, Sullivan; Mochizuki, Pál, Wickelgren (later rigorous treatments); Grothendieck's 1983 letter to Faltings mentions the real case
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); La Longue Marche (1981); Esquisse d'un programme (1984) on discrete groups and fixed points

ideas.what: Choice of lifts of rho at the orbifold point -j and the other classes obtained by conjugation by tau_i
ideas.modern_name: Orbifold points of order 3 of M_{0,4} and the 3-relation of the Grothendieck-Teichmueller group
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), discussion of the Teichmueller tower and its 2- and 3-relations

deep.surprise_reason: Careful, correct explicit bookkeeping of torsion lifts and half-twists in the level-(0,3) Teichmueller group. Everything is classical (braid and mapping-class relations, Nielsen-type fixed-point correspondence, real section correspondence), and Grothendieck himself sketched it in published or circulated texts.
transcription_corrections: 'Sauf les deux derniers (lesquels ce n'est pas possible*)' should read 'Sauf les deux derniers (pour lesquels ce n'est pas possible*)'.

Margin note should read roughly '*en effet |rho-dot tau| = |rho-dot^{-1} tau| = emptyset', i.e. the fixed-point sets of rho tau and rho^{-1} tau are empty. The 'rho^i rho tau' in the transcription is a misreading.
The involutions listed are the images in T_{0,3} (dotted): sigma-dot_0, sigma-dot_1, sigma-dot_infinity, tau, tau'-dot_0, tau'-dot_1, tau'-dot_infinity.
The group containing eps_i uses the same script letter as S_{0,3} on the previous page; 'Gamma_{0,3}' in the transcription is likely a misreading of that letter.
'deux pôles -j-bar, -j' is probably 'deux points -j-bar, -j' (the two fixed points of rho).
